name: Axom AI Helmet Detection System
publisher: Axom AI Research Laboratory, Guwahati, Assam, India
author: Samarjit Kashyap & Axom AI Team
model_type: Real-Time Computer Vision Helmet Enforcement System
base_architecture: Ultralytics YOLOv8s (fine-tuned) + YOLOv8s (motorcycle localization) + YOLOv8n-cls (head crop classifier)
primary_capabilities: Motorcycle and bicycle rider localization in CCTV and phone footage
Per-rider tracking across frames to eliminate duplicate alerts
Real-time violation alerts to Telegram, Web Admin Dashboard, and Android App
Automatic evidence capture with timestamp and high-resolution crop

compute_requirements.benchmark_hardware: Standard desktop Intel Core i3 / i5 processor

data_sovereignty_and_privacy: 100% on-premise execution; sensitive camera credentials never transmitted to external cloud; alert evidence restricted to authorized administrators.
